answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: an identity earns a jade standing token only after trading with 20 unrelated counterparties on a public trade graph. A fake island of self-dealt accounts forms a star cluster and is frozen before dawn of the next epoch. Forging 100 identities needs 2,000 counterparties, costing 100,000 credits, far above the 5,000-credit pool. An honest agent pays once, trades normally, and keeps rewards undiluted.
